ops.body:
PR #240 (branch hooks/guard-sessions-precision, head 323eab21) adds a same-line variable resolver and makes four command guards resolve before denying.

Resolver API (framework):
- `captain_hook/bindings.py`: `Scope(text, parent, exported)` with `resolve(raw, offset) -> Resolved(candidates, splittable) | Unresolved(source)`, `Known`/`Unknown` events, `child(...)`, `lookup`, `in_function`, `unreadable()`; helpers `segments`, `dequote`, `tokens`, `head_of`. A name resolves only when every assignment to it is a literal, unconditional, top-level statement or a `for` head (inside the loop body). Readers, declarers, arrays, `+=`, mutations, shell-owned vars, positional params -> Unknown. `eval`/`source`/`case`/`select`/`declare -n`/IFS/unreadable `$(...)` -> unreadable from that offset. Function bodies never resolve.
- `captain_hook/cmd.py`: `Call.resolve(word)`, `Call.word_targets(word)`, `Call.resolved_targets(words)`, `Cmd.scope`, `Cmd.scope_for(call, word)` (double-quoted payload -> host scope; single-quoted shell payload -> exports + host env prefix; `$(...)` -> substitution body child), `cd_operand`, `env_bindings`.
- `captain_hook/command_schema.py`: `Arguments.call`, `paths()` uses `word_targets` for expansion words, `glob_prefix(path)`; `PathMatches` also tests the glob prefix.
- Limits (fail-closed): CANDIDATE_LIMIT 16, CANDIDATE_LENGTH 4096, VARIANT_LIMIT 16, RecursionError -> unreadable.

Guard changes: guard_sessions `opaque_command_name` -> `head_reason` (unresolved head denies only when an argument/value/unreadable source names a guarded program); kill `-0` with one double-quoted or single-variable target and `pkill -0 <pat>` allowed; orca `--help`/`-h`/`help` and inspect verbs (`worker-show`, `task-list`, `file open-changed`) allowed, ORCA_GROUPS += file/help/linear/vm; performance broad-find denies only on resolved broad roots; find `-exec` block scoped to broad roots (`BROAD_FIND_ROOT`); guard_rm resolves `$VAR` targets, scratch-prefixed globs skip the count limit, run-time globs block.

Still denied (confirm-step candidates for the core lane): `rm -f "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/REBASE_HEAD"` (substitution target); find roots from `$(mktemp -d)`/`$(ls ...)`; the backtick `?replace` row; `orca terminal send --text "$B"` where B is `$(sed ...)`.

Caveats: `kill -0 $PID` single-variable allowance trusts that PID holds one word (codex finder #32, kept per brief); `for t in <literal handles>; orca terminal send --terminal $t` rows now allow though classification.md marked them justified (the loop items are literal); deletions scratch count-limit tests rewritten (`test_glob_limit`, new `test_glob_limit_outside_scratch`).

Lane friction: incident-retro hook blocks `pytest` under run_in_background ("Run retro.py prose ... never with run_in_background"); `tests/test_pack_graphite.py::test_hooks_stay_silent_when_ccx_declines_the_gt_lane[submit-gate]` and `test_snapshot_client.py::test_foreground_graph_latency_stays_bounded_while_registry_warms` flake under xdist, pass alone. `orca serve` and `orca agent` were run once by mistake while deriving the verb set (both exited without side effects: single-instance lock / no input).

Final state: head f93f4754 (rebased onto origin/main 8951b149 after a commands.py adjacency conflict with #237), CI green (run 36944929798), Documentation and Guides green, no review-bot threads at report time. Test fix in the rebase: test_variable_cd_threads_the_cwd compared against /private/tmp, which is macOS-only; now str(Path('/tmp').resolve()).

Tooling finding: the first push (323eab21) drew no CI run and ccx reported 'CI unconfirmed'; close/reopen did not help. Cause: GitHub skips pull_request workflows when the PR has a merge conflict with its base, and gh pr view showed mergeable=UNKNOWN. ccx vcs ship could detect this (merge-tree probe against the fetched base) and name the conflict instead of 'no CI run was registered'.
